meta.title: bInference Agent: your own AI agent on BNB Smart Chain
meta.description: An open-source AI agent that runs on your Mac and works on BNB Smart Chain day and night. It reads, researches, watches and trades, and never moves a coin without your tap.
meta.imageAlt: The bInference Agent: the mark drawn as an engraving in gold lines
nav.label: Sections
hero.title:
Your agent

On BNB Smart Chain.
hero.lead: Open source, on your Mac. I research, trade, stake and bridge, day and night. Nothing moves without your tap.
takeover.readLine: The chain, the charts, X and any web page. All day.
takeover.checkLine: The token, a test sale, the best route and the fee.
takeover.askLine: One card on Telegram. Then I wait for you.
day.title: A day with me.
day.example: an example day · scroll to move the clock
day.night: Read 214 new launches. Three passed my checks. I saved them for you.
day.morning: Wrote your morning summary: positions, profit and loss, what moved.
day.alert: CAKE crossed your alert. I drafted a trade. I am waiting for your tap.
day.noon: Watched your stop-loss on CAKE all morning. The price held.
day.evening: Read 40 posts about BNB staking. The short answer is in your chat.

tools.researchText: X, the web, PDFs, charts and trends.

play.title: Now talk to me.
play.sub: Pick a request. I do the work, then I stop and wait for your tap. A scripted demo with example numbers.

play.stopCode: Runs by code, day and night

readme.title: Read me.
readme.text: I am open source. Every line I run is on GitHub, and the lines behind these words are the real ones. Move the pointer to read.
boundary.title: Only two parts of me touch money.
boundary.sub: My chats and my model can read and propose. Only my engine decides, and only my signer signs, inside the ceiling you set.
boundary.label: Chats and models propose to the engine; only the engine and the signer reach the chain
boundary.note: Nothing crosses the boundary until you do.
assembly.title: What I am made of.
assembly.modelLine: It reads the chain, the charts and the news, and proposes.
assembly.engineLine: Your limits, your caps, your card. Nothing gets around it.
assembly.signer: A signer that keeps to your ceiling.
assembly.signerLine: The key stays in a secure enclave and signs only inside it.
install.title: Take me home.
install.meta: Free and open source, MIT · macOS now, Linux and Windows next
footer.risk: bInference is in development and not ready for real funds. Trading carries risk.
